title: Skip interleaved MCP stdio notifications
goal: Allow the Core harness MCP stdio transport to ignore valid server notifications before a response while preserving malformed JSON and mismatched response-id failures.

results.change: StdioTransport now skips blank lines and JSON-RPC notification envelopes before returning a response; response-shaped messages remain subject to McpClient JSON-RPC version and id correlation checks
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 17 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness MCP transport only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, or credential changes
